title: Dabigatran for extended secondary prevention after venous thromboembolism
question: In adults who have completed anticoagulation for venous thromboembolism, does extended dabigatran reduce recurrence compared with the comparator each trial actually randomised against?
why_this_is_its_own_question: The population has already been treated. The counterfactual is continuation versus stopping, which is why one trial here randomises against placebo and one against warfarin -- and why those two cannot be pooled.

split_from.why: The parent's four trials span three different readings plus one that is not a VTE trial. Choosing one reading would have discarded the other questions silently, so the topic was SPLIT rather than narrowed.

trials.registered_primary_description_verbatim: Endpoint is a composite of recurrent Venous Thromboembolic Event (VTE) and death related to VTE. VTE was defined as the composite of symptomatic Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT) of the leg and Pulmonary embolism (PE). All recurrent VTEs required objective verification by definitive diagnostic evaluation. In case of death, autopsy was an additional way to confirm VTE.
